_what_this_is: SOURCE 1 of the Deny requirement triangulation: the INCIDENT LEDGER. Every entry is an escalation path a prior gate established by evidence, not a restatement of what the policies happen to deny.
_why_it_is_outside_the_repository: Gate 4N-I7 Defect 2. scripts/must_not_contract.py both DEFINED the forbidden set and supplied the expectation the tests measured, so deleting one line shrank the policy and the expectation together and the suite stayed green while two principals silently dropped from EXPLICIT_DENY to IMPLICIT_DENY. Across 135 Deny actions, ~80 were individually removable. A requirement source inside the repository cannot fix that.

entries.consequence: The ECS path: PassRole is checked at RegisterTaskDefinition/RunTask, so a principal holding it can run a task AS a more privileged role. Closed at 4N-H4; the Gate 4N-I6 suite then stayed green with the Deny removed, which is how the regression was found.
BR-2: CreateRole takes an arbitrary trust document and needs no boundary unless one is required by condition, so the holder can mint a successor with permissions it lacks.

Mints long-lived credentials that outlive every session control.
Creates a principal outside Identity Center, invisible to permission-set retirement.
Stops recording the actions that would show every other escalation.
